description: This Java class 'AggregationRepository' provides methods for performing aggregation queries (average, max, min, sum, count) on time-series data stored in a TimescaleDB database, using JPA EntityManager and custom SQL queries.

classes.name: AggregationRepository
classes.description: Repository class for executing aggregation queries on TimescaleDB time-series data.

methods.name: findAvg
methods.description: Executes the 'findAvg' SQL query to retrieve average values over a time range.

methods.name: findMax
methods.description: Executes the 'findMax' SQL query to retrieve maximum values over a time range.

methods.name: findMin
methods.description: Executes the 'findMin' SQL query to retrieve minimum values over a time range.

methods.name: findSum
methods.description: Executes the 'findSum' SQL query to retrieve sum values over a time range.

methods.name: findCount
methods.description: Executes the 'findCount' SQL query to retrieve count of values over a time range.

methods.name: getResultList
methods.description: Helper method to execute a named query with parameters and return result list.
